message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are present in the data acquisition code; the dataset and sampler classes load and process data without validating structure or types.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths (hardcoded relative paths like '../data/amap_traffic_...') with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks for any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms to defend against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code imports `load_checkpoint` from mmcv.runner but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed when loading pretrained weights anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label distribution validation: The code uses class-balanced samplers but performs no explicit check or assertion on label distribution or expected label set before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard SGD with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus or TF Privacy) or DP-SGD noise mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: The evaluation loop only runs standard forward passes with no adversarial attack generation (FGSM, PGD, Foolbox, ART, etc.) at any point.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, signed/hashed evaluation data, or any protection against metric manipulation; the eval function simply computes F1 and confusion matrix on whatever dataloader is passed in.
No detected input sanitization: The eval/inference path directly passes raw data from the dataloader to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation on the inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly via argmax without any NaN checks, probability sanity bounds, or threshold validation before being stored or returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image classification pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
